affected_predicate.description: All #openTalk lectures in the actual current month are added to Calendar with their time, location, topic, and required reminder offset.

competing_trace_defects.description: Before the reuse target, the agent independently interpreted the singular current month as the multi-month range “Oct–Dec 2025” and scanned on that basis.

chains.rationale: At reuse target step 19, the agent repeated the incorrect “Oct–Dec 2025” premise and the same Mastodon feed scroll. Every subsequent observable action through step 50 was another scroll, with many static transitions and no correction, Calendar navigation, event creation, or reminder configuration. The repeated scanning mechanism therefore remained unbroken while the affected calendar-event predicate stayed visibly unfulfilled.

summary: The sole strict-MHR reuse target continued the incorrect multi-month scanning premise into an uninterrupted feed-scrolling loop through the last observable step; no Calendar event work or recovery is visible.
